name: le0daniel/php-ts-bindings
description: Type-safe RPC between a PHP 8.5 backend and a TypeScript frontend, driven by your PHPStan types.

suggest.laravel/framework: Enables the first-party Laravel adapter: config, routes, and the operations:* artisan commands.
suggest.phpstan/phpstan: Include vendor/le0daniel/php-ts-bindings/extension.neon so Pick, Omit, BrandedString, BrandedInt and DateTimeString resolve.
suggest.psr/container: Required only by PsrContainerAdapter. Install it to resolve handlers and middleware through a PSR-11 container; the default NewInstanceAdapter needs nothing.

scripts-descriptions.check:style: Check formatting with Pint (psr12) without writing. Run fix:style to apply.
scripts-descriptions.check:ts: Typecheck the committed generated TypeScript with tsc --noEmit. Needs node; check:all does not.
scripts-descriptions.codegen:fixture: Regenerate tests/ts-output/generated and typecheck it with tsc --noEmit. Run after changing a code generator; commit the result.
scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Time cached vs eager operation registries over the integration fixtures. Informational; not part of check:all or CI.
